messages:
nate: seeing intermittent outbound failures from edge sidecars -> external S3/model-registry. started ~02:15 UTC. curl to s3 times out / TLS handshake reset.
ashley: same, metrics show conntrack_count spike on node pool 'edge-ssd-eu'. NAT translations show many connections in TIME_WAIT.
carl: do we SNAT at nodes or at egress-gateway? iirc we rely on MASQUERADE on nodes for pod egress
maya: envoys are in the path (sidecar + egress gateway). egress-gw is 10.64.10.4 LB -> NodePort
nate: quick dump of iptables POSTROUTING on node:
```
-A POSTROUTING -s 10.0.0.0/16 ! -d 10.0.0.0/16 -j MASQUERADE --to-ports 1024-65535
-A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j CNI-MASQ
```
ashley: looks like CNI chain exists but our egress-gw path might bypass it sometimes (DNAT to gateway ip), so return packets have original pod src -> dropped at gateway because SNAT was not applied
carl: also seeing huge ephemeral port reuse, looks like SNAT pool is being depleted -> connection resets
maya: quick test: curl --interface eth0 to model-store.s3.amazonaws.com works; from pod goes via envoy and fails
nate: mitigation idea: add explicit MASQUERADE rule for traffic leaving via egress-gw iprange, or enable preserve_source_ip=false on egress-gw so it SNATs properly
ashley: short-term we can add an iptables rule on nodes:
```
iptables -t nat -I POSTROUTING 1 -s 10.0.0.0/16 -d 0.0.0.0/0 -j MASQUERADE
```
maya: tagging @oncall since this affects production pulls :oncall: 
deploy-bot: deployed k8s patch 'egress-policy-2026-03-18' to canary
infra-bot: note: adding MASQUERADE globally may hide original source for logging. consider using SNAT with limited port range and monitoring conntrack
carl: can we also update envoy egress policy to allow 443 out to *.s3.amazonaws.com and preserve original dest? saves DNAT fiddling
nate: i'm going to roll the iptables patch to all edge nodes and monitor, will follow up with metrics in 10m :eyes:
ashley: thanks. please post conntrack and ephemeral port metrics after
maya: filing follow-up: ticket INFRA-4532 to track longer-term fix (preserve source via LB + increase port range + egress-gw SNAT config)
nate: +1
carl: thx team :thumbsup:
